name: Wykobi
listed_description: A C++ library of efficient, robust and simple to use C++ 2D/3D oriented computational geometry routines.
reason: The repo README (opened) has no performance or benchmark section; the claim word is only 'efficient'. wykobi.com is blocked here. The one third-party numeric comparison found is an OSGeo FOSS4G geometry-libraries benchmark seen only as a WebSearch snippet (page not openable, dev.svn.osgeo.org and the Boost geometry mailing list archives unreachable): it shows Wykobi tying CGAL on area (both 0.109 s), slower than CGAL on convex hull (1.437 s vs 0.875 s) and slower than Boost.Geometry on rectangle clip (0.578 s vs 0.203 s), so it is not evidence of beating CGAL either.
